"""Build distribution p over N=150000 with exact forward and backward KL of 10.0 vs uniform.

Identities with q = N*p (so mean(q) = 1):
    KL(P||U) = sum_i p_i log(N p_i)        = E_q[log q]      ... wait, = sum p log q
    KL(U||P) = -sum_i (1/N) log(N p_i)     = -E[log q]
So we need: sum p = 1, E_p[log q] = -10, E_p[q log q] = 10
(i.e. mean(q)=1, mean(log q)=-10, mean(q*log q)=10).
Three constraints -> three probability levels with FIXED weights (spike weight is an
exact rational m/N, not a rounded float, so the moments stay exact).
"""
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import root

N = 150_000
TOL = 1e-3
TARGET = 10.0


def build(n_spike=7, frac_mid=0.5, guess=(10.0, -4.0, -12.0), tag=""):
    f = n_spike / N                      # exact rational spike weight
    g = frac_mid * (1.0 - f)             # mid-tail weight
    h = 1.0 - f - g                      # low-tail weight
    w = np.array([f, g, h])
    assert abs(w.sum() - 1.0) < 1e-15

    def resid(lx):
        a = np.exp(lx)
        q = w * a                        # q_i = N p_i on each level
        return [w @ a - 1.0,             # mean(q) = 1     -> normalisation
                w @ lx + TARGET,         # mean(log q) = -10 -> backward KL
                w @ (a * lx) - TARGET]   # mean(q log q) = 10 -> forward KL

    best = None
    for gx in [guess, (8.0, -6.0, -11.0), (12.0, -2.0, -14.0), (6.0, -8.0, -10.0)]:
        sol = root(resid, np.array(gx, dtype=float), method="hybr", tol=1e-14)
        r = float(np.max(np.abs(resid(sol.x))))
        if sol.success and r < (best[1] if best else np.inf):
            best = (sol.x, r)
        print(f"  {tag} guess={gx} ok={sol.success} res={r:.3e}")
    assert best is not None and best[1] < 1e-10, "moment solve failed"

    a = np.exp(best[0])
    counts = [n_spike, int(round(g * N)), N - n_spike - int(round(g * N))]
    q = np.empty(N, dtype=np.float64)
    idx = 0
    for cnt, val in zip(counts, a):
        assert cnt > 0
        q[idx:idx + cnt] = val
        idx += cnt
    assert idx == N
    # exact float64 renormalisation (relative change ~1e-16, harmless)
    q *= N / q.sum()
    return q / N, a, counts


def report(p, tag):
    q = N * p
    U = np.full(N, 1.0 / N)
    kl_f = float(np.sum(p * np.log(p / U)))
    kl_b = float(np.sum(U * np.log(U / p)))
    ok = (abs(kl_f - TARGET) <= TOL and abs(kl_b - TARGET) <= TOL
          and abs(p.sum() - 1.0) <= 1e-9 and np.all(np.isfinite(p)) and p.min() > 0)
    print(f"[{tag}] KL(P||U)={kl_f:.12f} (err {abs(kl_f-TARGET):.3e})  "
          f"KL(U||P)={kl_b:.12f} (err {abs(kl_b-TARGET):.3e})  ok={ok}")
    return ok


best = None
for n_spike in (7, 8, 100, 1000):
    for frac_mid in (0.5, 0.25):
        p, a, counts = build(n_spike=n_spike, frac_mid=frac_mid, tag=f"m={n_spike},fm={frac_mid}")
        ok = report(p, f"m={n_spike} fm={frac_mid}")
        print(f"   levels={a} (log={np.log(a)}) counts={counts} min_p={p.min():.3e} max_p={p.max():.6f}")
        if ok and (best is None or n_spike == 7):
            best = p

assert best is not None
np.save("/app/dist.npy", best)
print("saved /app/dist.npy", best.dtype, best.shape)

cd /app && cat > solve_dist.py <<'PY'
"""Distribution p over N=150000 with KL(P||U)=10 and KL(U||P)=10.

With q = N*p:
   KL(P||U) = (1/N) * sum q_i log q_i
   KL(U||P) = -(1/N) * sum log q_i
so we need mean(q)=1, mean(log q)=-10, mean(q log q)=10.

Use a 3-level distribution with INTEGER counts (n1,n2,n3) summing to N, so the
level weights are exactly n_i/N and the three moment equations determine the
three levels (a1,a2,a3) exactly (no rounding of weights).
"""
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

N = 150_000
TARGET = 10.0
TOL = 1e-3

n1, n2 = 6, 75_000
n3 = N - n1 - n2
counts = np.array([n1, n2, n3], dtype=np.float64)
w = counts / N

def moments(A):
    A = np.clip(A, -700.0, 700.0)
    a = np.exp(A)
    mean_q = w @ a
    mean_log = w @ A
    mean_qlogq = w @ (a * A)
    return np.array([mean_q - 1.0, mean_log + TARGET, mean_qlogq - TARGET])

A0 = np.array([10.1, -4.0, -16.0])
sol = least_squares(moments, A0,
                    bounds=([9.0, -40.0, -80.0], [12.0, -0.01, -1.0]),
                    xtol=1e-15, ftol=1e-15, gtol=1e-15, max_nfev=20000)
A = np.clip(sol.x, -700.0, 700.0)
res = moments(A)
print("solver cost", sol.cost, "max|res|", np.max(np.abs(res)), "A", A)
assert np.max(np.abs(res)) < 1e-9, "moment solve not accurate enough"

a = np.exp(A)
q = np.concatenate([np.full(n1, a[0]), np.full(n2, a[1]), np.full(n3, a[2])])
assert q.size == N
p = q / q.sum()          # exact float64 normalisation (relative change ~1e-16)

U = np.full(N, 1.0 / N)
kl_f = float(np.sum(p * np.log(p / U)))
kl_b = float(np.sum(U * np.log(U / p)))

print(f"levels a = {a}")
print(f"counts   = {n1}, {n2}, {n3}")
print(f"sum(p)   = {p.sum():.17f}  min={p.min():.6e}  max={p.max():.6f}  dtype={p.dtype}")
print(f"KL(P||U) = {kl_f:.12f}  err={abs(kl_f-TARGET):.3e}")
print(f"KL(U||P) = {kl_b:.12f}  err={abs(kl_b-TARGET):.3e}")

ok = (abs(kl_f - TARGET) <= TOL and abs(kl_b - TARGET) <= TOL
      and abs(p.sum() - 1.0) <= 1e-9 and np.all(np.isfinite(p))
      and p.min() > 0 and p.size == N)
print("all conditions satisfied:", ok)
assert ok
np.save("/app/dist.npy", p)
print("saved /app/dist.npy", p.shape, p.dtype)
